overview: EXPO proposes a sample-efficient online RL algorithm for fine-tuning expressive policies (e.g., diffusion, flow-matching) by avoiding direct value maximization over the expressive policy, instead using a lightweight Gaussian edit policy to refine base policy actions and an on-the-fly non-parametric action selection mechanism to maximize Q-value for both sampling and TD backup.

modules.name: Base Expressive Policy Architecture
modules.description: Implements the diffusion policy network with DDPM parameterization, including the denoising U-Net or MLP backbone with residual blocks, noise schedule (variance preserving), and forward sampling procedure for generating actions conditioned on states and diffusion timesteps.

modules.name: Edit Policy Architecture
modules.description: Implements the lightweight Gaussian edit policy that takes state and base action as input and outputs a bounded action edit (delta), with a tanh-scaled output clamped by the edit distance hyperparameter beta, and a learnable log-std for entropy computation.

modules.name: Q-Function Critic Ensemble
modules.description: Implements an ensemble of Q-networks (critics) with target networks, including the twin/triple min-Q trick for overestimation reduction, network initialization, and the soft target update mechanism with tau smoothing.

modules.name: On-the-Fly (OTF) Policy Module
modules.description: Implements the core OTF action extraction logic: sampling N actions from the base policy, applying the edit policy to generate N edited actions, computing Q-values for all 2N candidates, and selecting the action with the highest Q-value. This module is used for both environment interaction and TD backup.

modules.name: Base Policy Training (Imitation Learning)
modules.description: Implements the DDPM denoising loss for training the base expressive policy via imitation learning on offline and online replay buffer data, including random timestep sampling, noise injection, and the epsilon-prediction objective.

modules.name: Edit Policy Training (Q-Maximization)
modules.description: Implements the entropy-regularized policy loss for training the edit policy to maximize Q(s, a + a_hat) minus alpha * log pi_edit(a_hat|s, a), including reparameterization trick for the Gaussian, and automatic entropy tuning or fixed alpha scheduling.

modules.name: Q-Function Training with OTF Backup
modules.description: Implements the TD learning objective for Q-function training, where the target uses the OTF policy to select the value-maximizing action at the next state, computes the target as r + gamma * Q_target(s', a_tilde_star), and minimizes the MSE loss across the critic ensemble.

modules.name: Entropy Backup Module
modules.description: Implements the soft sampling distribution pi_sampling with Boltzmann-weighted action selection for data-limited regimes, computing the closed-form entropy of this distribution and incorporating it into both the TD target and the policy loss to encourage broader exploration.

modules.name: Replay Buffer and Offline Data Management
modules.description: Implements a replay buffer that initializes with offline demonstration data and accumulates online transitions, supporting batch sampling with oversampling from offline data, and managing the storage of (s, a, r, s') tuples across both data sources.

modules.name: Environment Interaction and Rollout Collection
modules.description: Implements the environment interaction loop using the OTF policy for action selection, collecting (s, a, r, s') transitions, storing them in the replay buffer, and handling episode resets with proper state normalization if applicable.

modules.name: Main Training Loop and Workflow Control
modules.description: Implements the overall training orchestration including the UTD (update-to-data) ratio control, alternating between environment steps and gradient updates, managing the sequential updates of Q-function, base policy, and edit policy within each training iteration, and optional offline pretraining phase.

modules.name: Evaluation and Metrics
modules.description: Implements evaluation protocols for sparse-reward tasks, computing success rates over multiple evaluation episodes, handling task-specific success conditions (Antmaze goal reaching, Adroit dexterous manipulation, Robomimic/MimicGen object manipulation), and normalized return calculation.

modules.name: Ablation Experiment Framework
modules.description: Implements controlled ablation configurations including: (1) OTF policy for sampling only vs. both sampling and TD backup, (2) with vs. without action edits, (3) varying offline dataset sizes, (4) varying the number of action samples N, and (5) varying the edit scale beta.

modules.name: Configuration and Hyperparameter Management
modules.description: Implements a configuration system managing all hyperparameters including edit policy beta (per-task), number of action samples N, UTD ratio, Q-ensemble size, discount factor, target update tau, learning rates, pretraining steps, and dataset specifications across Antmaze, Adroit, Robomimic, and MimicGen domains.

modules.name: Logging, Checkpointing, and Experiment Tracking
modules.description: Implements training logging for Q-values, policy losses, success rates, and entropy statistics; checkpoint saving and loading for base policy, edit policy, and Q-function; and integration with experiment tracking tools for multi-seed result aggregation and performance curve visualization.
